trigger: Before starting a software project task that changes workflow assets from a pi session
When planning, reviewing, or validating project-governance work on the pi platform

native_entry.note: pi natively loads AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md context files (no trust gate) and implements the Agent Skills spec: SKILL.md trees discovered recursively, name/description injected into the system prompt, full instructions loaded on demand, /skill:name commands. Global wiring uses settings.json skills/prompts path arrays pointing at repo-absolute paths (user ruling #1).

ask_user_question.evidence: extension-bridged: adapters/pi/extension registers model-only tool ask_user_question rendering via ctx.ui dialog methods (select/confirm/input) — available in tui and rpc modes (rpc via extension_ui_request/response subprotocol); headless json/print modes have no UI and the tool fails fast with GOV_ASK_USER_HEADLESS (official precedent examples/extensions/question.ts L53-62). Design FEASIBLE per docs/requirements/pi-adapter-design-0.99.0.md evidence table; runtime E2E verification pending → degraded until then (same enumeration precedent as claude adapter: native tool exists, verified surface limited).
ask_user_question.degraded_mode: In headless pi runs (-p / --mode json), use the outer host conversation for interaction boundaries; interactive/RPC pi sessions use the bridged tool.

sub_agent.evidence: extension-bridged: adapters/pi/extension registers model-only tool dispatch_agent spawning a nested pi process (--mode json -p --no-session --append-system-prompt <role definition> --tools <subset> --exclude-tools ask_user_question,dispatch_agent) per the official examples/extensions/subagent reference; role-definition + task-spec + dispatch-prompt semantics align with references/agent-dispatch-template.md. Design FEASIBLE; runtime E2E verification pending → degraded until then.
sub_agent.degraded_mode: Until agent-runtime E2E passes, require external reviewer evidence for Producer-Reviewer separation claims; after E2E passes, upgrade status with machine-recorded evidence.

tool_calling.evidence: pi has native read/bash/powershell/edit/write/grep/find/ls built-in tools; --tools allowlist with +name/-name deltas; powershell is native on Windows.

browser.evidence: No built-in browser automation tool; pi-web-access package unverified for a declarable channel.
browser.degraded_mode: Mark browser validation blocked or run it from another host adapter.

mcp.evidence: MCP mechanism is native (mcp.json + pi mcp CLI + registerMcpServer) but server availability depends on host configuration.
mcp.degraded_mode: Use local scripts and record MCP unavailable when not configured.

git_hooks.evidence: Git hooks are repository-level controls installed into .git/hooks/ and remain active for pi-driven changes.

workflow_closure.evidence: pi achieves extension-bridged ask_user_question and sub_agent (tui/rpc interactive scope), native tool_calling and git_hooks; browser/mcp remain host-dependent; bridge runtime E2E pending.

exploration_channels.note: M10.3 four behavior-semantic channels materialized for this platform. consult never maps draw: generation is not consultation (生成≠咨询 — canonical rule marker synced from behavior-protocol.md M10.3, drift-guarded by check-cross-references; origin review-FEAT-085-DESIGN-R0 F-3). Honest degradation is legal; capability masquerade is an EXP-03 violation.

discover.evidence: No native web search tool in the pi built-in set; pi-web-access package is not a verified declarable channel.
discover.degraded_mode: Record 判定=受限 per EXP-03; degrade to local knowledge with disclosed limits; never mark offline knowledge as search results.

inspect.mapping: read / grep / find / ls native tools

consult.mapping: dispatch_agent extension bridge (nested pi role agents) for structured second opinions; no external source verified
consult.evidence: Extension-bridged sub_agent can carry consult-style role prompts (design FEASIBLE, E2E pending); no external (web or cross-model) professional source is verified; ask_user is a user channel, not an external consult channel; draw-style generation is not consultation (R0 F-3).
consult.degraded_mode: Record the external-source limit per EXP-03 when consult needs information or judgment beyond the host's own bridged sub-agents.

validate.evidence: Native shell tools execute the validation contract commands (runtime_capabilities.tool_calling native).

exploration_channels.degraded_mode: When a channel is unavailable, record 判定=受限 in the exploration block (M10.2) per EXP-03; never mark offline knowledge as channel results.

runtime_e2e.evidence: Runtime version probe verified: pi --version returns 1.1.0 (exit 0, machine-recorded in docs/research/pi-adapter-integration-research-0.98.0.md §1). Adapter landed with FEAT-100; agent-runtime E2E upgrades this to real-agent-target-cwd when it executes (mixed scope: real agent-dir read-only credentials + --no-session, zero write surface).

target_cwd_e2e.blocked_reason: Pending FEAT-100 acceptance; mixed-scope approval granted by user ruling 3, execution scheduled

agent_runtime_e2e.evidence: Matrix entry designed (design §6.3); run after implementation lands and registration diff is merged.
agent_runtime_e2e.blocked_reason: Pending FEAT-100 acceptance; matrix entry lands with the implementation, run agent-runtime-e2e --agent pi to upgrade
